classification.event_product_type: Category spotlight (gold coins and luxury watches) — Owner filed under notable-lot

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Seller name top-centre → GOLD (metallic gold letters) & WATCHES (navy) → date (red) → time (navy) → seven watches in one row with mirror reflections → navy footer band with gold stars and the URL. Two gold coins flank the title.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: Seven watches standing in a row on a reflective white floor, each fully visible (Breitling, Bulgari, two-tone Rolex GMT, Rolex Datejust, Rolex Yacht-Master II, gold rectangular dress watch, Rolex Cellini); American Gold Eagle coin obverse and reverse at the top corners.
visual_read.composition_style: Symmetrical lineup; title centred above; reflections instead of shadows; footer band.
visual_read.typography_treatment: The word GOLD rendered as dimensional gold metal — the Owner's cited example of truthful event typography; & WATCHES in heavy navy sans; date in red condensed caps.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Seller name and 'AUCTIONS' at the top; URL in the navy footer band.
visual_read.footer_treatment: Full-width navy band with the URL in white and gold stars.
visual_read.photographic_style: Clean product photography on a reflective white surface; consistent scale across watches.
visual_read.environmental_staged_composition: A display-case lineup; no room implied.

strongest_attributes: GOLD in gold — typography that tells the truth about the merchandise
A lineup lets buyers compare like objects at a glance; every dial visible
Coins flanking the title give the two-word title its two subjects (gold / watches)
Three copy blocks plus the footer band
transferable_lessons: Lineups are legitimate for homogeneous category groups (watches, coins, guitars, bottles) — the 3M 'no lineups' language should be scoped to broad scene ads
Truthful material typography (gold for gold) is approved; never imply materials the lots do not have
Reflections are an alternative to shadows on a white floor for small precious objects
do_not_generalize: Navy/red/gold palette, star ornaments, the seller's condensed sans
Metallic lettering as a default effect — only when the material claim is true
Watch brand names are lot facts, not style

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: Title, date, time; the row of watches needs no explanation.
text_density_assessment.advantage_bid_budget_note: Under budget; a category spotlight can be this quiet when the objects speak.

composition_assessment.spatial_logic: Display-case row on a reflective plane.
composition_assessment.gravity_and_grounding: All seven watches share one floor line; reflections confirm it.
composition_assessment.depth: Single plane; slight overlaps between adjacent bracelets.
composition_assessment.scale_strategy: Uniform watch scale for comparison; coins slightly larger than life to hold the corners.
composition_assessment.edge_handling: Contained; the outer watches sit inside the edges.

provenance.analysis_method: Direct visual inspection of the full-resolution image; pixel statistics computed from the file; est_* fields are visual estimates. No filename-based inference.
